payload.claim: [host-filed criterion probe] tests/test_intake.py::test_a_queued_spec_declaring_an_inline_mutant_is_refused_and_a_retired_one_parses stayed green with the criterion's own edit applied to saffron/intake.py. The claim was '`discover_specs` refuses a spec any of whose criteria declares `mutant:` inline. The refusal is a `DiscoveryFailure` carrying the parsed spec, and its reason names the witness. Called with `retired=True`, it parses that spec with its inline mutant intact. `refuse_inline_mutants` raises `InlineMutantError`, a `SpecError` carrying the spec. A criterion that declares `subject:` and no inline mutant now parses.'.
